title: Tanker 1H 2026: Strong VLCC Earnings Drive Newbuilding and Secondhand Investment
section_path: Tanker 1H 2026: Strong VLCC Earnings Drive Newbuilding and Secondhand Investment
section_path_text: Tanker 1H 2026: Strong VLCC Earnings Drive Newbuilding and Secondhand Investment

Image reference: pexels-atmadeep-das-1776637129-28247236.jpg | assets/2026-09-02_tanker-1h-2026-strong-vlcc-earnings-drive-newbuilding-and-secondhand-investment_img_pexels-atmadeep-das-1776637129-28247_28f5ca7edab3.jpg
This week's Allied QuantumSea Research examines tanker fleet and orderbook developments during the first half of 2026, covering fleet growth, age profiles, deliveries, removals and the forward supply outlook. Freight-market strength following the disruption around the Strait of Hormuz pushed VLCC asset values higher during the first half. Demand was particularly strong in the secondhand market, where prices for five-year-old vessels rose above comparable newbuilding levels.
